reason: 该插件面向用户的主要用途是增强聊天界面显示：在 DeepSeek Harness 的 composer 底部栏中展示当前会话 ID 并可快速复制，属于会话标识可见性与操作效率提升的界面增强，依据仓库清单与 README 显示其为前端 bundle 注入式插件。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 会话 ID 显示插件，在输入框下方展示当前会话 ID，并支持用户点击后复制。
summaries.en: This plugin for DeepSeek Harness shows the current session ID under the composer and lets users copy it with a click.

capabilities: injects a UI element into the composer dock area
displays the current session identifier in the interface
copies displayed session id text on user click with clipboard fallback

reasons.code: README and description state the plugin shows the current session id under the composer and supports one-click copy.
package.json exposes a DSH web client bundle and patch-based bundle registration, indicating UI-only loading path.
Architecture section describes slot injection at conversation.composer.dock with no host-side logic beyond registration.
